verses.original: מַשָּׂ֥א דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְיֹסֵ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְיֹצֵ֥ר רֽוּחַ־ אָדָ֖ם בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh nō·ṭeh šā·ma·yim wə·yō·sêḏ ’ā·reṣ wə·yō·ṣêr rū·aḥ- ’ā·ḏām bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: This is the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel Thus declares the LORD who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth who forms the spirit of man within him
verses.literalPt: Oráculo da palavra de Jeová acerca de Israel. Assim diz Jeová, que estende os céus, que lança os alicerces da terra e que forma o espírito do homem dentro dele.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָ֠נֹכִי שָׂ֣ם אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם סַף־ רַ֛עַל לְכָל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְגַ֧ם עַל־ יְהוּדָ֛ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה בַמָּצ֖וֹר עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî śām ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim sap̄- ra·‘al lə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḡam ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh yih·yeh ḇam·mā·ṣō·wr ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Behold I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples Judah will be besieged as well as Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Eis que farei de Jerusalém um campo de titubeação a todos os povos em redor, e sobre Judá também virá ela no cerco contra Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּוֹם־ הַ֠הוּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־ עֹמְסֶ֖יהָ שָׂר֣וֹט יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ וְנֶאֶסְפ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm- ha·hū ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim ’e·ḇen ma·‘ă·mā·sāh lə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm kāl- ‘ō·mə·se·hā śā·rō·wṭ yiś·śā·rê·ṭū wə·ne·’es·p̄ū ‘ā·le·hā kōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: On that day when all the nations of the earth gather against her I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples all who would heave it away will be severely injured . . .
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, farei de Jerusalém uma pedra de carga a todos os povos; todos os que carregarem com ela serão gravemente feridos; e ajuntar-se-ão contra ela todas as nações da terra.

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה אַכֶּ֤ה כָל־ סוּס֙ בַּתִּמָּה֔וֹן וְרֹכְב֖וֹ בַּשִּׁגָּע֑וֹן וְעַל־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֶפְקַ֣ח אֶת־ עֵינַ֔י וְכֹל֙ ס֣וּס הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַכֶּ֖ה בַּֽעִוָּרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ak·keh ḵāl sūs bat·tim·mā·hō·wn wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw baš·šig·gā·‘ō·wn wə·‘al- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ep̄·qaḥ ’eṯ- ‘ê·nay wə·ḵōl sūs hā·‘am·mîm ’ak·keh ba·‘iw·wā·rō·wn
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD I will strike every horse with panic and every rider with madness I will keep a watchful eye on the house of Judah but I will strike with blindness all the horses of the nations
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz Jeová, ferirei de pasmo todos os cavalos e, de loucura, os que montam neles; abrirei os meus olhos sobre a casa de Judá e ferirei de cegueira todos os cavalos dos povos.

verses.original: וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אַלֻּפֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּלִבָּ֑ם אַמְצָ֥ה לִי֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū ’al·lu·p̄ê yə·hū·ḏāh bə·lib·bām ’am·ṣāh lî yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts The people of Jerusalem are my strength for the LORD of Hosts is their God
verses.literalPt: Os chefes de Judá dirão no seu coração: Os habitantes de Jerusalém são a minha força em Jeová dos Exércitos, seu Deus.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אָשִׂים֩ אֶת־ אַלֻּפֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה כְּֽכִיּ֧וֹר אֵ֣שׁ בְּעֵצִ֗ים וּכְלַפִּ֥יד אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָמִ֔יר וְאָ֨כְל֜וּ עַל־ יָמִ֧ין וְעַל־ שְׂמֹ֛אול אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם ע֛וֹד תַּחְתֶּ֖יהָ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- ’al·lu·p̄ê yə·hū·ḏāh kə·ḵî·yō·wr ’êš bə·‘ê·ṣîm ū·ḵə·lap·pîḏ ’êš bə·‘ā·mîr wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ‘al- yā·mîn wə·‘al- śə·mō·wl ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm sā·ḇîḇ wə·yā·šə·ḇāh yə·rū·šā·lim ‘ō·wḏ taḥ·te·hā bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot . . . in a woodpile like a flaming torch among the sheaves they will consume all the peoples around them on the right and on the left while the people of Jerusalem remain secure there
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, porei os chefes de Judá como um braseiro de fogo no meio de lenha e como uma tocha de fogo entre feixes. Eles devorarão à direita e à esquerda todos os povos em redor; e Jerusalém habitará ainda outra vez no seu lugar, isto é, em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְהוֹשִׁ֧יעַ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ אָהֳלֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן לֹֽא־ תִגְדַּ֜ל תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בֵּית־ דָּוִ֗יד וְתִפְאֶ֛רֶת יֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lê yə·hū·ḏāh bā·ri·šō·nāh lə·ma·‘an lō- ṯiḡ·dal tip̄·’e·reṯ bêṯ- dā·wîḏ wə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ yō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah
verses.literalPt: Também Jeová salvará primeiro as tendas de Judá, para que a glória da casa de Davi e a glória dos habitantes de Jerusalém não se engrandeçam sobre Judá.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָגֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּעַד֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהָיָ֞ה הַנִּכְשָׁ֥ל בָּהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּדָוִ֑יד וּבֵ֤ית דָּוִיד֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים כְּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yā·ḡên Yah·weh bə·‘aḏ yō·wō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·hā·yāh han·niḵ·šāl bā·hem bay·yō·wm ha·hū kə·ḏā·wîḏ ū·ḇêṯ dā·wîḏ kê·lō·hîm kə·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: On that day the LORD . . . will defend the people of Jerusalem so that the weakest among them will be like David and the house of David will be like God like the angel of the LORD going before them
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, defenderá Jeová os habitantes de Jerusalém; o que dentre eles tropeçar naquele dia será como Davi; e a casa de Davi será como Deus, como o Anjo de Jeová diante deles.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֲבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’ă·ḇaq·qêš lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim hab·bā·’îm ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So on that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, procurarei destruir as nações que vierem contra Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְשָׁפַכְתִּי֩ עַל־ בֵּ֨ית דָּוִ֜יד וְעַ֣ל׀ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם ר֤וּחַ חֵן֙ וְתַ֣חֲנוּנִ֔ים וְהִבִּ֥יטוּ אֵלַ֖י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ דָּקָ֑רוּ וְסָפְד֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּמִסְפֵּד֙ עַל־ הַיָּחִ֔יד וְהָמֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו כְּהָמֵ֥ר עַֽל־ הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄aḵ·tî ‘al- bêṯ dā·wîḏ wə·‘al yō·wō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim rū·aḥ ḥên wə·ṯa·ḥă·nū·nîm wə·hib·bî·ṭū ’ê·lay ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dā·qā·rū wə·sā·p̄ə·ḏū ‘ā·lāw kə·mis·pêḏ ‘al- hay·yā·ḥîḏ wə·hā·mêr ‘ā·lāw kə·hā·mêr ‘al- hab·bə·ḵō·wr
verses.literal: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer and they will look on Me the One they have pierced They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son
verses.literalPt: Derramarei sobre a casa de Davi e sobre os habitantes de Jerusalém o espírito de graça e de súplica. Olharão para mim, a quem traspassaram, e farão pranto sobre mim, como quem pranteia seu filho único; serão amargurados por causa de mim como quem o está por causa do seu primogênito.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִגְדַּ֤ל הַמִּסְפֵּד֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּמִסְפַּ֥ד הֲדַדְ־ רִמּ֖וֹן בְּבִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yiḡ·dal ham·mis·pêḏ bî·rū·šā·lim kə·mis·paḏ hă·ḏaḏ- rim·mō·wn bə·ḇiq·‘aṯ mə·ḡid·dō·wn
verses.literal: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, haverá um grande pranto em Jerusalém, como o pranto de Hadadrimom no vale de Megido.

verses.original: וְסָפְדָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת בֵּית־ דָּוִ֤יד לְבָד֙ וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ם לְבָ֔ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־ נָתָן֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·p̄ə·ḏāh hā·’ā·reṣ miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ lə·ḇāḏ miš·pa·ḥaṯ bêṯ- dā·wîḏ lə·ḇāḏ ū·nə·šê·hem lə·ḇāḏ miš·pa·ḥaṯ bêṯ- nā·ṯān lə·ḇāḏ ū·nə·šê·hem lə·ḇāḏ
verses.literal: The land will mourn each clan on its own the clan of the house of David and their wives - the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives . . .
verses.literalPt: A terra pranteará, cada família à parte: a família da casa de Davi à parte, e suas mulheres à parte; a família da casa de Natã à parte, e suas mulheres à parte;

verses.original: מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־ לֵוִי֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַשִּׁמְעִי֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: miš·pa·ḥaṯ bêṯ- lê·wî lə·ḇāḏ ū·nə·šê·hem lə·ḇāḏ miš·pa·ḥaṯ haš·šim·‘î lə·ḇāḏ ū·nə·šê·hem lə·ḇāḏ
verses.literal: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives . . . the clan of Shimei and their wives . . .
verses.literalPt: a família da casa de Levi à parte, e suas mulheres à parte; a família dos simeítas à parte, e suas mulheres à parte;

verses.original: כֹּ֗ל הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֥ת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōl ham·miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ han·niš·’ā·rō·wṯ miš·pā·ḥōṯ miš·pā·ḥōṯ lə·ḇāḏ ū·nə·šê·hem lə·ḇāḏ
verses.literal: and all the remaining clans - and their wives . . .
verses.literalPt: todas as mais famílias, cada família à parte, e suas mulheres à parte.
